ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 70% high-intensity pixels (light grey/white) in the fluke interior vs 30% low-intensity pixels (black) concentrated at the perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad, contiguous low-intensity black banding along the entire trailing edge and distal tips. One prominent isolated dark circular pixel cluster is located in the posterior-medial region of the left lobe. Smaller focal dark spots are visible adjacent to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with sharp peaks and varied-depth valleys mapped across the continuous trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory on both lobes, tapering and sweeping toward the distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular indentation and loss of edge continuity on the extreme outer margin of the left fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-contrast dark circular point located at the extreme apex of the right fluke tip.
